test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

Eight friends, Janak, Kuldeep, Punit, Kavita, Naveen, Azad, Vikas and Anil, are sitting around a square table, four of them are sitting at the four corners and the rest four are sitting at the middle of each of the four sides of the table. The ones who sit at the corners face the centre, while those who are sitting in the middle of the sides face away opposite to the centre of the table. Janak faces the centre and is third to the right of Azad. Naveen faces the centre, but is not an immediate neighbour of Azad. Only one person is sitting between Azad and Vikas. Kavita is sitting second to the right of Kuldeep. Kuldeep faces the centre. Punit is not an immediate neighbour of Janak.

Which of the following statements is true regarding Punit?

options.text: Kuldeep sits third to the left of Punit.
Punit is an immediate neighbour of Azad.
Punit is an immediate neighbour of both Azad and Janak.
Punit faces away from the centre of the table.

solution:
**Given:**

Number of friends=8 

Name:Janak, Kuldeep, Punit, Kavita, Naveen, Azad, Vikas and Anil.

**Explanation:**

 
• Four of them are sitting at the four corners and the rest four are sitting at the middle of each of the four sides of the table.
 
• The ones who sit at the corners face the center, while those who are sitting in the middle of the sides face away opposite to the center of the table.
 
• So, the representation will be as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d51983fb683b2031ab2e78ccd87c4fd8ff777343e1391cc769bc203e0ec9d239.png] 

 
• Janak faces the centre and is third to the right of Azad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a2fff27c7afc865ecbea29ad6317d42c7497d221f5b5f3e95e5601bedd9daac.png] 

 
• Naveen faces the center but is not an immediate neighbour of Azad. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/956d272a8bdbd176cc2552ae0b7347ba671e5577a926d8bcd1673642c7b32e9f.png] ​

 
• Kavita is sitting second to the right of Kuldeep. Kuldeep faces the centre.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91b34a5afd9b2f22ccab85e4ad188b4cc9bda13ed03f157128e1aa4314c0f7e3.png] ​

 
• Punit is not an immediate neighbour of Janak.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bb83fd30c872a931519aaf9acfcc41b566ad75c96089a4b4590777383652e0e.png] 

 
• Only one person is sitting between Azad and Vikas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c15ee7ebd9f870344376b3e9ee60f8e00f10172dec9e749ef2c03ea7d894902.png] 

The above representation is the final arrangement.

 
• So, Kuldeep sits third right to Punit. Option 1 is false.
 
• Punit is an immediate neighbour of Naveen and Kavita. Options 2 and 3 are discarded.
 
• Punit faces away from the centre of the table 

Hence,** "****Punit faces away from the centre of the table" **is the correct answer.

e9
